fields.name: CommandID
fields.semantics: Server-owned or idempotency-mapped 128-bit command identity.

fields.name: ProviderID
fields.semantics: Opaque or monotonic provider identifier scoped to identity sso signin-start request; it binds the exact owner and authority snapshot, is canonicalized before lookup, and conveys no authority without separate authorization.

fields.name: Domain
fields.semantics: Bounded canonical domain for identity sso signin-start request; entries remain unique and within configured owner and consent authority, and absence cannot broaden access.

fields.name: SuccessCallback
fields.semantics: Exact canonical success callback for identity sso signin-start request; it is selected from configured allowlists, compared byte-for-byte and never derived from an inbound host.

fields.name: ErrorCallback
fields.semantics: Exact canonical error callback for identity sso signin-start request; it is selected from configured allowlists, compared byte-for-byte and never derived from an inbound host.

fields.name: LoginIntent
fields.semantics: Validated login intent returned or accepted by identity sso signin-start request; its declared type and finite bound are enforced, its authority is limited to the surrounding contract, and redaction follows that contract.

fields.name: RedirectURI
fields.semantics: Exact canonical redirect uri for identity sso signin-start result; it is selected from configured allowlists, compared byte-for-byte and never derived from an inbound host.

fields.name: TransactionID
fields.semantics: Opaque or monotonic transaction identifier scoped to identity sso signin-start result; it binds the exact owner and authority snapshot, is canonicalized before lookup, and conveys no authority without separate authorization.

fields.name: ProviderID
